description: Get field-level band changes of the newest published date for up to 50 tickers: day-over-day for daily, week-over-week for weekly. Each change is {field, from, to}; Plus and Pro also get stability, periods_in_current_state and recent flips. ticker_context gives each ticker's last_changed_date. Use it for 'what changed for AAPL, MSFT and NVDA today?' instead of pulling full summaries; use get_summary for one ticker's full state.

timeframe.description: daily (day-over-day) or weekly (week-over-week). Daily snapshots are Pro and Commercial only (Free and Plus read weekly; daily returns 403). Default: daily on Pro and Commercial, weekly on Free and Plus

name: get_changes

data.description: The TickerDB API response payload for this tool call.
